sentences.text: Counter affidavit filed by the Complainant is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and Sri Akhilesh Singh Chauhan, learned Counsel for the complainant and perused the record.
3.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.416 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 306, 504,
506 IPC, Police Station Bilgram, District Hardoi.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant 21 years ago, subsequently on 03.08.2023, an information was received that she had hanged herself to death.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report is shown as asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was visible on the body of the deceased.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the allegations levelled in the FIR as well as in the statements, there appears to be nothing on record to demonstrate the abetment at the instance of the applicant as defined under Section 107 of IPC and also considering the law laid down in the case of Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs Inspector of Police; 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387 coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 07.08.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

entities.text: Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs Inspector of Police; 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Dheerendra Dixit be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
